# Environment Setup

## Install and Load Libraries

```r
install.packages("renv")
renv::restore()
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-libraries
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(arcgislayers)
library(arrow)
library(geoarrow)
library(janitor)
library(mapgl)
library(here)
library(fs)
```

## Project Configurations

### Arrow Initialization

```r
# Only run if this is the first time using `arrow` package on this device
arrow::install_arrow()
```

### Path Configuration

```{r}
#| label: setup-dirs
# Setup Paths & Params
dirs <- list(
  source = here::here("_src"), # Source custom functions
  raw = here::here("_data/raw"), # Input: Shapefiles, GDBs, CSVs
  processed = here::here("_data/processed"), # Intermediate Output: Standardized Parquets
  buffered = here::here("_data/buffered"), # Intermediate Output: Buffered layers
  isochrones = here::here("_data/isochrones"), # Intermediate Output: ORS Isochrones
  results = here::here("_output") # Final Output: Analysis Results
)

purrr::walk(dirs, ~ fs::dir_create(., recurse = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-subdirs
# Define Sub-directories (To match your existing structure)
sub_dirs <- list(
  base = here::here(dirs$processed, "base_layers"),
  parcels = here::here(dirs$processed, "parcels_taz"),
  landuse = here::here(dirs$processed, "landuse_zones"),
  transport = here::here(dirs$processed, "transportation"),
  access = here::here(dirs$processed, "access"),
  amenities = here::here(dirs$processed, "amenities")
)

purrr::walk(sub_dirs, ~ fs::dir_create(., recurse = TRUE))
```

### Projection Constants

```{r}
#| label: setup-crs
# Projection Constants
CRS_STP <- "EPSG:3566" # NAD83 / Utah Central (Projected - ftUS)
CRS_UTM <- "EPSG:26912" # NAD83 / UTM zone 12N (Projected - meters)
CRS_WGS <- "EPSG:4326" # WGS84 (Geographic - Lat/Lon)
```



## Helper Functions

```{r}
#| label: load-helpers
source(here::here(dirs$source, "prepare_layers.R")) # Manifest runner + atomic publish (load first)
source(here::here(dirs$source, "download_feature_layer.R")) # Download ArcGIS Feature Layers
source(here::here(dirs$source, "process_local_layer.R")) # Load local SHP, GDB, GeoJSON Layers
source(here::here(dirs$source, "preview_layer.R")) # Preview (geo)parquet files using mapgl
```

# Data Sources

Every layer is declared in `_src/sources.yml` (ArcGIS download, local file, or the TAZ + ATO join).
To add a layer, add an entry there — no new chunk is needed.

```{r}
#| label: load-sources
sources <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here(dirs$source, "sources.yml"))$layers
```

# Prepare Layers

Layers that already exist are skipped, and a failed layer does not stop the others.
Outputs are written to a `.tmp` path and only renamed on success, so an interrupted run
never leaves a half-written parquet that looks cached.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-layers
status <- prepare_layers(sources, sub_dirs = sub_dirs, crs = CRS_WGS)
status
```

To run a subset or force a rebuild:

```r
status <- prepare_layers(sources, sub_dirs, only = c("bikeways", "wf_taz"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Preview

```{r}
#| label: preview
#| eval: false
# Replace the key with any entry from sources.yml
preview_source("municipal_bounds", status, sources)
```

# Quality Control & Manifest

```{r}
#| label: qc-manifest
#| eval: false
# Anything not "ok" / "cached" needs attention
status[status$status == "failed", c("key", "error")]

# Output sizes (a zero-byte or missing file means the layer needs a re-run)
file_info <- fs::dir_info(dirs$processed, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.parquet")
file_info[, c("path", "size")]
```
